timeline.message:
Refactor scalar functions and have them implement use a common class
that implements EvaluatorMapper.
Move fold() to the super class.
timeline.author: Andrei Stefan

diff.patch:
@@ -331,3 +331,10 @@ row true_bool = null is null, false_bool = null is not null, negated_true = not(
 true_bool:boolean | false_bool:boolean | negated_true:boolean | negated_false:boolean
 true              | false              | false                | true
 ;
+
+staticCidrMatch
+row x = cidr_match(to_ip("127.0.0.1"), "127.0.1.0/16"), y = cidr_match(to_ip("127.0.0.1"), "127.1.0.0/16") | eval ip = to_ip("127.0.0.1") | eval z = cidr_match(ip, "127.0.0.1");
+
+x:boolean | y:boolean  |  ip:ip     | z:boolean
+true      |false       |127.0.0.1   |true        
+;

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105376
Creates two new ESQL specific base classes for functions, eliminating boilerplate code from many concrete function implementations.

+issues:

timeline.body: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Do you think this should be final? I'll be it can't be final now, but maybe it can be one day?

reply.body: It can probably be final in the future, but for now `case` has its own implementation. `now` has something different as well. And the "constant" functions (pi, e, tau)
